digest_comparison.what_was_compared_with_what: PyPI publishes a sha256 for every file of a release (urls[].digests.sha256). Each file of the release (wheel and sdist) was downloaded and its sha256 computed locally: each equals the published sha256. Where the profile row pins a sha256 it is the wheel's, and equals the local sha256.

source_commit_resolution.note: PyPI files carry no source commit; the source is identified by the git tag below
source_commit_resolution.method: git ls-remote https://github.com/<repo>.git refs/tags/<tag> refs/tags/<tag>^{} (an annotated tag lists its object and, peeled, its commit; a lightweight tag lists only the commit); for npm packages the version document's gitHead and, when it differs from the tag commit, the GitHub compare API between the two
